sentences.zh: 所以，说了这么多，

sentences.en: here's some takeaways from that that I wanted to sit down because all of the guests that we had when we did cults and conspiracy theories had a pretty specific focus.
sentences.zh: 我想把其中的一些收获总结一下，因为我们做邪教和阴谋论专题时请的所有嘉宾都有相当具体的侧重点。

sentences.en: And that's great, you know, but not everybody is kind of synthesizing all the information that I'm trying to synthesize.
sentences.zh: 这当然很好，你知道，但并不是每个人都在综合我试图综合的所有信息。

sentences.en: They're talking about their specific, um, area of expertise because that's what a guest is supposed to do.
sentences.zh: 他们在谈论自己特定的，嗯，专业领域，因为那本来就是嘉宾该做的事。

sentences.en: And so to kind of synthesize that, I was hoping I could get, um, scheduling with Allison and, uh, James, because I know that they have some, uh, experience with these things,
sentences.zh: 为了把这些内容整合起来，我本来希望能够，嗯，和艾莉森以及詹姆斯敲定档期，因为我知道他们对这些事情有一些，嗯，经验，

sentences.en: but maybe we can do that later.
sentences.zh: 不过也许我们以后再做吧。

sentences.en: Um, so the first thing is like, I want to make a distinction between a cult and a conspiracy theory.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以第一点是，我想区分一下邪教和阴谋论。

sentences.en: Um, you know, cults are something that, or cults are high control groups is a word that you hear used now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，邪教就是那些，或者说邪教就是高度控制团体，这是你现在经常听到的一种说法。

sentences.en: There are things that take over and run a huge part of your life and then later replace your identity.
sentences.zh: 它们会接管并控制你生活的大部分，然后彻底取代你的身份。

sentences.en: I know that these things, there's a Venn diagram.
sentences.zh: 我知道这些东西之间有交集。

sentences.en: I can hear you already saying in your head, yeah, but conspiracy theories do that too, but let me get through it.
sentences.zh: 我甚至能听到你在心里反驳说“对啊，但阴谋论也是这样”，不过先听我把话说完。

sentences.en: Like the cults, um, tend to operate by having sometimes through a charismatic leader, um, sometimes through, you know,
sentences.zh: 像邪教，嗯，往往通过某种方式运作，有时是通过一个具有个人魅力的领袖，嗯，有时是通过，你知道的，

sentences.en: a teaching or some sort of ritual process of trusting the process.
sentences.zh: 一种教义或者某种信任这个过程的仪式化流程。

sentences.en: What they do is they take you and they say, here are all of these things that you need.
sentences.zh: 它们对你做的是，它们会找到你并对你说：“看，这些就是你所需要的一切。”

sentences.en: Um, and then that diagnosis is usually right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且这种诊断通常是准确的。

sentences.en: If you look at somebody like a Keith Renier, if you look at somebody like, um, Keith Renier is of the NXIVM cult, which the documentary, The Vow and, uh, what's the other one,
sentences.zh: 如果你看看像基思·拉尼尔这样的人，如果你看看像，嗯，基思·拉尼尔是“克西姆”（NXIVM）邪教的头目，纪录片《誓言》和，嗯，另外那部叫什么来着，

sentences.en: Seduced?
sentences.zh: 《诱惑》？

sentences.en: Uh, there may be a third one now, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在可能还有第三部，我不知道。

sentences.en: Uh, what they're doing is they're going up and they're making a diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们所做的，就是走上前去给你做一个诊断。

sentences.en: So he goes up to Sarah Edmondson and he says, you're coughing, but you're not sick.
sentences.zh: 所以他走到莎拉·埃德蒙森面前对她说：“你在咳嗽，但你没生病。”

sentences.en: And you're doing that because you think that you have to be sick to get attention.
sentences.zh: “你这么做是因为你觉得只有生病才能引起注意。”

sentences.en: Who are you without that?
sentences.zh: “如果没有了这些，你又是谁？”

sentences.en: And it changes her life because she's like, I've done this my whole life.
sentences.zh: 这彻底改变了她的人生，因为她心想：“我一辈子都在这么做。”

sentences.en: My dad gave me attention when I was sick or whatever she does.
sentences.zh: “我生病时我爸就会关注我”或者诸如此类的事。

sentences.en: I don't remember her, um, psychoanalysis of herself, but she says basically that woke her up.
sentences.zh: 我不记得她对自己是怎么进行心理分析的了，但她说基本上是这句话点醒了她。

sentences.en: So then she's kind of in a vulnerable state where she feels like she doesn't know who she is, but she's ready for growth.
sentences.zh: 于是她陷入了一种脆弱的状态，觉得自己失去了自我认知，但她已经准备好成长了。

sentences.en: She sees this thing that's been holding her back.
sentences.zh: 她看到了这个一直拖累她的问题。

sentences.en: And then Keith Renier says, okay, you got to do this process.
sentences.zh: 然后基思·拉尼尔就说：“好吧，你得经历这个过程。”

sentences.en: And you understand how, and I'm not going to go through the whole NXIVM indoctrination, but the diagnosis is right.
sentences.zh: 你懂的，我就不赘述NXIVM完整的洗脑过程了，但那个诊断是准的。

sentences.en: You know, charismatic leaders, cults, if it's like a text or something that people can kind of project on or sort of vague or has a process,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，具有个人魅力的领袖、邪教，如果是一个文本或者某种人们可以把自我投射上去的东西，或者说比较模糊、有一套流程的东西，

sentences.en: it's going to leave room for people to do this diagnostic part.
sentences.zh: 它就会给人们留下空间来进行这种自我诊断。

sentences.en: In a way that is unique to them, because not everyone's running from a different thing.
sentences.zh: 这种方式对每个人来说都是独一无二的，因为每个人逃避的东西都不一样。

sentences.en: We all have a different shadow.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都有不同的心理阴暗面。

sentences.en: And so what Keith Renier did, and what most cult leaders are able to do is come up and say, oh my gosh, you have a father wound.
sentences.zh: 所以基思·拉尼尔所做的，以及大多数邪教头目所能做到的，就是走过来对你说：“哦天哪，你有着恋父情结。”

sentences.en: You have a father shaped hole, and you've been trying to stuff that with drugs your whole life.
sentences.zh: “你心里有一个父亲形状的空洞，你一辈子都在试图用毒品去填补它。”

sentences.en: And you've been trying to stuff that with music and this other identity and sex or whatever.
sentences.zh: “你一直在试图用音乐、另一种身份、性或者其他什么东西来填补它。”

sentences.en: And now you're trying to make me be your father and project that energy on me, but I'm not going to accept it.
sentences.zh: “现在你想让我当你的父亲，把这种能量投射到我身上，但我绝不接受。”

sentences.en: You need to become your own father, you know.
sentences.zh: “你需要成为你自己的父亲，你知道的。”

sentences.en: And the person's like, oh, wow, you know, that diagnosis is real, right?
sentences.zh: 然后那个人就会想：“哦，哇，你知道吗，这个诊断太准了，对吧？”

sentences.en: But somebody can diagnose what you're running from and you're suffering, and they can still have a prescription that is complete bullshit.
sentences.zh: 但是，一个人可以诊断出你在逃避什么、在遭受什么痛苦，而他们开出的药方却完全是狗屁不通。

sentences.en: And sort of that is what advertising is, right?
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，广告就是这样的，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, and, you know, and advertising isn't necessarily a cult, but they are operating on that same mechanism where Starbucks is saying in the 90s, hey,
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，广告不一定是个邪教，但它们的运作机制是一样的，比如星巴克在90年代说，嘿，

sentences.en: you think a coffee shop is like a cat and some books or whatever.
sentences.zh: 你以为咖啡馆就是一只猫配几本书之类的东西吗？

sentences.en: That isn't.
sentences.zh: 根本不是。

sentences.en: It's a new way of life, okay?
sentences.zh: 这是一种崭新的生活方式，好吗？

sentences.en: If you're younger, you have no idea what I'm talking about, okay?
sentences.zh: 如果你比较年轻，你根本不知道我在说什么，好吗？

sentences.en: Because you don't remember what the world was before Starbucks.
sentences.zh: 因为你不记得星巴克出现之前的世界是什么样子的了。

sentences.en: But Apple Computer, if you're, you know, some of you may be too young to remember this, but it was like they came on the scene and they said, this computer is not, like,
sentences.zh: 但是苹果电脑，如果你，你知道的，你们当中有些人可能太年轻而不记得了，但当时他们横空出世，他们说，这台电脑不是，就像是，

sentences.en: and I'm specifically talking about their advertising, you know.
sentences.zh: 我特指他们的广告，你知道的。

sentences.en: Don't send me an email and say, well, computers used to not be intuitive, and Steve Jobs wanted to say, well, this is a bicycle for your brain.
sentences.zh: 别给我发邮件说“以前电脑很不直观，史蒂夫·乔布斯想说，这可是你大脑的自行车”。

sentences.en: This is supposed to work.
sentences.zh: “这东西本来就该好用。”

sentences.en: Okay, I'm not talking about the actual product.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我不是在谈论实际的产品。

sentences.en: I'm talking about the way it was marketed, okay?
sentences.zh: 我是在谈论它的营销方式，好吗？

sentences.en: So, like, Apple Computer said, here's an artist blowing dust off a thing they built in their studio, and they have this Apple Computer, and they have this thing,
sentences.zh: 所以，就像苹果电脑会说，看呐，这是一个艺术家在吹掉他们在工作室里打造的东西上的灰尘，他们有一台苹果电脑，他们有这个玩意儿，

sentences.en: and here's this guy going on this long journey, and the iPad's in the leather case, and he's a, you know, bespoke gentleman checking his thing.
sentences.zh: 然后这是一个正在进行漫长旅程的家伙，iPad装在皮套里，他是一个，你知道的，定制西装的绅士正在查看他的设备。

sentences.en: And they were trying to say these people live intentionally, they live artistically, they have a very small quantity of very nice things,
sentences.zh: 他们想表达的是，这些人是有意图地生活，他们像艺术家一样生活，他们只拥有少量的极其美好的东西，

sentences.en: because those nice things cost a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 因为那些美好的东西要花很多钱。

sentences.en: You know, the computer is next to the heirloom watch or knife, because it's going to be the same thing, it's going to last forever.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，电脑旁边放着传家宝手表或小刀，因为它们是一类东西，它们能永久保存。

sentences.en: Creativity, eating, sexuality, emotions.
sentences.zh: 创造力、饮食、性欲、情感。

sentences.en: And it's this moment of like liberation for the whole groom because they have this moment where they're allowed to have humor and oh, isn't this so funny?
sentences.zh: 而对整个教派来说，这就像是一个解放的时刻，因为他们终于迎来了可以拥有幽默感的片刻：“哦，这难道不好笑吗？”

sentences.en: And you're turning the humor, the humanness of the group off by repressing emotion and humor and then giving them permission to enjoy it.

sentences.zh: 而且我不是那个做出这种联系的人。

sentences.zh: 关于这个课题有着大量的学术研究，历史由来已久。

sentences.en: But when you're looking for the original person, because, you know, a lot of the things when you're looking at the cult leader, right?
sentences.zh: 但当你去寻找最初的根源时，因为，你知道的，当你审视邪教领袖时，对吧？

sentences.en: Like a delusion, spirit, I don't think spirit, I'm not one of those therapists that I'm not Freudian.
sentences.zh: 就像妄想、精神——我不认为精神……我不是那种弗洛伊德派的治疗师。

sentences.en: I don't think that spirituality is delusional.
sentences.zh: 我不认为灵性就是妄想。

sentences.en: I know a ton of people who, when you're going back to the brain science we talk about of the front brain and the subbrain, where they're front,
sentences.zh: 我认识一大群人，当你回顾我们讨论过的前脑与下脑的大脑科学时，也就是他们的前脑……

sentences.en: they had a moment where their subbrain turned, their front brain turned off.
sentences.zh: 他们经历过这样一个时刻：他们的下脑在运转，前脑关闭了。

sentences.en: Their subbrain was incredibly active.
sentences.zh: 他们的下脑极其活跃。

sentences.zh: 然后他们把这些体验讲给我听。

sentences.en: And they're telling me that they went into this place where they saw a connection to all things.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，他们进入了这样一个境界：他们看到了与万物的联系。

sentences.en: They have a profound empathy for creation.
sentences.zh: 他们对万物苍生抱有极深厚的同理心。

sentences.en: They don't identify with their ego as much.
sentences.zh: 他们不再那么执着于自己的小我（ego）。

sentences.en: They still want to be a person, but they don't really care about being a powerful or right or proud or whatever person.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然想做一个普通人，但他们根本不在乎自己是不是一个强大、正确、骄傲或者别的什么了不起的人。

sentences.en: And they just want to be loving and good and connected to other people.
sentences.zh: 他们只想充满爱心、善良，并与他人保持连接。

sentences.en: And they had this spiritual experience, you know, in that subbrain place.
sentences.zh: 他们在下脑所在的那个地方获得了这种灵性体验，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying that that isn't real or it doesn't come from a medical physical thing.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说那不是真的，或者它不是源于某种医学的、生理的现象。

sentences.en: I'm a therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是个治疗师。

sentences.en: I'm not a prieSt.
sentences.zh: 我可不是神父。

sentences.en: And when you talk to them, it's working out for them.

sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们戒了酒。

sentences.en: They went to this place.
sentences.zh: 他们去过那种境界。

sentences.zh: 这种改变在他们余下的人生中一直发挥着作用。

sentences.zh: 我认识很多经历过这种转变的人。

sentences.en: And I think that that is interesting.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很有意思。

sentences.en: I don't know where it comes from.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这究竟源于何处。

sentences.en: But that kind of spirituality, I'm not saying it's bad because it's not logical.
sentences.zh: 但那种灵性体验，我并不是说它是坏事，仅仅因为它不符合逻辑。

sentences.en: I don't think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我不认为那是对的。

sentences.en: But a delusion where there is, and you have an experience in the subbrain that is beyond logic, that is beyond language, that is beyond time.
sentences.zh: 但如果是一种妄想——当你拥有某种超越逻辑、超越语言、超越时间的下脑体验时——

sentences.en: It feels spiritual.
sentences.zh: 它感觉起来就很神圣。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: Which is what makes it, that's why I think people say, well, all spiritual people are just delusional.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，这也是为什么我认为人们会说：“哦，所有追求灵性的人都只是产生了妄想。”

sentences.en: Or all spiritual people are just weak and they're trying to find a way to make themselves so powerful.
sentences.zh: 或者“所有追求灵性的人都只是软弱无能，试图找到一种让自己变得强大的方法”。

sentences.en: That definitely is a dynamic.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是其中一种心理动态。

sentences.en: I don't think that's behind all spirituality.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这并不是所有灵性的底层驱动力。

sentences.zh: 我曾在宗教和世俗环境中与各种人群促膝长谈，大半生都在和宗教打交道。

sentences.en: I just, I don't.

sentences.zh: 但当你看看像艾米·卡尔森纪录片里的那种人，也就是关于艾米·卡尔森的《爱已获胜》纪录片，她在吸毒，喝着一五分之二加仑装的伏特加。

sentences.en: And saying, well, for you, these are drugs, but for me, they're spiritual tools.

sentences.zh: 好的，所以当你试图去了解某个人时，只要注意他们是如何对待那些体验的就行了。

sentences.zh: 但你知道，这些邪教的背后正是这种心理。

sentences.zh: 我，我很抱歉，我想我在那里表现得很政治化，因为当你在社会中没有通往自我实现的途径时，

sentences.en: when you have no pathway to there's a lot of things that are part of that economic stability, education, access to health care,

sentences.en: And in the worst case, not that much worse than the present, when you, you know, a way to actualize your goals, your potential, when you don't have that,
sentences.zh: 最坏的情况下，也不会比现在糟糕太多，当你，你知道的，有一种途径去实现你的目标、你的潜力，当你没有这些时，

sentences.zh: 你开始出现邪教是不可避免的。

sentences.zh: 就像你可以追溯到罗马帝国，当它运转不那么顺畅的时候。

sentences.en: And people are able to look at, you know, earlier generations were like, we're conquering all this stuff.
sentences.zh: 人们能够回顾，你知道的，前几代人会觉得，我们在征服所有这些东西。

sentences.zh: 高卢人正在街头游行示威。

sentences.zh: 他们带来了大象和这些我从未见过的动物，并说我们征服了这些国家。

sentences.zh: 你有所有这些东西可以拿。

sentences.zh: 你拿到了粮食配给卡，这很棒。

sentences.en: You know, you're it's successful.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你，这很成功。

sentences.en: And then the empire starts to decline.
sentences.zh: 然后帝国开始衰落。

sentences.en: And so they say, OK, well, here's the football game.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，好吧，这是橄榄球赛。

sentences.en: Watch this to be entertained and get your libidinal rage out.
sentences.zh: 看这个来获得娱乐，发泄你的力比多愤怒。

sentences.en: But don't think about how like you're not actually getting what you want.
sentences.zh: 但不要去想你实际上是如何没有得到你想要的东西的。

sentences.en: Go to the gladiatorial thing and cheer on your team or watch whatever.
sentences.zh: 去角斗场为你的团队欢呼，或者随便看点什么。

sentences.en: I mean, they invest in the gladiatorial stuff.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们投资角斗活动。

sentences.en: Rome does when they want to distract you from the crumbling empire that is making your quality of life worse.
sentences.zh: 当罗马想要转移你对正在恶化你生活质量的崩溃帝国的注意力时，他们就会这样做。

sentences.en: That only works for so long.
sentences.zh: 这只能管用一段时间。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，会出现像密特拉教、军队中的密特拉教这样的东西，这是心理上的必然。

sentences.en: You know, an army cult is going to be scary because when your whole army converts to a religion,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，一个军队邪教将会是可怕的，因为当你的整个军队都皈依了一种宗教，

sentences.en: at a certain point, are they going to do what the emperor tells them to do?
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他们还会听从皇帝的命令吗？

sentences.en: You know, you're going to get things because when I don't have actual active power out here,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你会遇到各种情况，因为当我在现实世界中没有实际的活跃权力时，

sentences.en: then what happens is I'm going to I'm unless I just say I give up, I'm going to jump off a bridge.
sentences.zh: 那么会发生什么呢，我要么，除非我直接说我放弃，否则我要去跳桥。

sentences.en: There's no point in my life, which that person, you know, politically, I guess, ceases to matter after that point.
sentences.zh: 我的生活毫无意义，你知道的，在那之后，从政治角度来看，这个人似乎就不重要了。

sentences.en: Just it's sad.
sentences.zh: 只是，这很悲哀。

sentences.en: I'm not saying they don't matter, but I'm saying that they're no longer affecting the political process.
sentences.zh: 我不是说他们不重要，但我是说他们不再影响政治进程了。

sentences.en: If you check out from society and go off into the woods, then what happens is I move inward and I start to find mysticism, esotericism.
sentences.zh: 如果你退出了社会，隐居山林，那么接下来发生的是，我向内探索，开始寻找神秘主义、秘契主义。

sentences.en: You know, all the people who get bullied in high school, like those people are going to go, you know, inward and play D&D or be an actor,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所有在高中被霸凌的人，那些人会，你知道的，向内转，玩龙与地下城，或者当演员，

sentences.en: do something that involves masking and ritual and accessing and mapping parts of my internal self.
sentences.zh: 做一些涉及面具、仪式以及接触和绘制我内在自我地图的事情。

sentences.en: And those aren't bad things to do.
sentences.zh: 这些并不是坏事。

sentences.en: But when you have no power that is effective, available to people actively, when they know that if I can vote right or vote left or go up or go down, it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 但是，当人们手中没有切实可行、随时可用的权力时，当他们知道如果我投右翼或左翼的票，或者向上或向下，都无济于事时。

sentences.en: I'm going to get the same result.
sentences.zh: 我会得到同样的结果。

sentences.en: The political process doesn't really reflect my ego, my interests.
sentences.zh: 政治进程并不能真正反映我的自我、我的利益。

sentences.en: Then they look for that power personally.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始在个人层面寻找这种权力。

sentences.en: And sometimes that leads to people who become cool artists and write cool stuff.
sentences.zh: 有时这会造就那些成为酷炫艺术家并写出酷炫作品的人。

sentences.en: But as a inevitability, you're going to get cults and conspiracy theories because people are going to say, one, I'm going to go to a cult leader who says,
sentences.zh: 但作为一种必然，你会得到邪教和阴谋论，因为人们会说，第一，我要去找一个邪教领袖，他会说，

sentences.en: this is how you feel better.
sentences.zh: 这就是让你感觉好点的方法。

sentences.en: This is how you do it right.
sentences.zh: 这就是你正确做事的方式。

sentences.en: I'm telling you why you feel bad.
sentences.zh: 我来告诉你为什么你感觉不好。

sentences.en: Just statistically, that's going to happen more.
sentences.zh: 仅从统计学上讲，这种情况会更多地发生。

sentences.en: You're also going to have people who find a conspiracy theory and say, this system makes me meaningful and powerful and gives me action.
sentences.zh: 你也会遇到这样的人，他们发现了一个阴谋论并说，这个系统让我变得有意义、有力量，并赋予我行动力。

sentences.en: Posting on the internet, going to this rally, sharing this information, biting back.
sentences.zh: 在网上发帖，去参加集会，分享这些信息，进行反击。

sentences.en: I mean, you get that language in the conspiracy theory in a way you don't get in the cult.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你在阴谋论中使用的语言，在邪教中是找不到的。

sentences.en: I mean, the cult is saying, we're going to tell you what to do.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，邪教是在说，我们会告诉你该怎么做。

sentences.en: You don't need to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 你不需要自己去弄明白。

sentences.en: The conspiracy theory is like helping you infer what gives you agency.
sentences.zh: 阴谋论则像是帮你推断出是什么赋予了你自主权。

sentences.en: So, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不知道。

sentences.en: I hope that that's helpful.
sentences.zh: 我希望这有帮助。

sentences.en: I hope that that's an interesting summary.
sentences.zh: 我希望这是一个有趣的总结。

sentences.en: I'm trying to think if there's any part of that that I didn't get to.
sentences.zh: 我在想要不要讲讲其中我没有涉及的部分。

sentences.en: Some of those are rabbit holes that I could have gone down longer.
sentences.zh: 其中有些是我可以深入探讨的兔子洞。

sentences.en: But I think all of those things are things that were touched on in the cults and conspiracy theories podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 但我认为所有这些都是在邪教和阴谋论播客中涉及过的事情。

sentences.en: If you're interested in that, I'm just kind of giving you a lot of different bullet points that you may want to look at more.
sentences.zh: 如果你对此感兴趣，我只是给你列出很多你可能想进一步了解的不同要点。

sentences.en: I definitely think that there is a pretty profound – and some people don't like it when I use the more Jungian language on the show, but I do think it's useful.
sentences.zh: 我绝对认为存在一个相当深刻的——有些人不喜欢我在节目中使用更多荣格式的语言，但我确实认为它很有用。

sentences.en: We all have intuition.
sentences.zh: 我们都有直觉。

sentences.en: And when we're cut off from intuition, things get, you know, pretty dark.
sentences.zh: 当我们与直觉切断联系时，事情就会变得，你知道的，相当黑暗。

sentences.en: They get pretty sad.
sentences.zh: 它们变得相当悲惨。

sentences.en: We may look like we're a successful doctor, lawyer, wealthy person, like doing whatever,
sentences.zh: 我们看起来可能是一个成功的医生、律师、富有的人，不管在做什么，

sentences.en: but we don't feel like we're able to be in touch with the part of our brain that is more than logic, that is more than language, that is more than time.
sentences.zh: 但我们并不觉得自己能够接触到我们大脑中超越逻辑、超越语言、超越时间的那部分。

sentences.en: And so that saying of like if you don't have a religion, then something will become your religion that, you know, I remember hearing a bunch of people say that in the 70s.
sentences.zh: 所以那句话说，如果你没有宗教，那么某些东西就会成为你的宗教，你知道的，我记得在70年代听许多人说过。

sentences.en: I went to live in the 70s, but in what I'm reading and watching things, so I don't know who exactly said that.
sentences.zh: 我可不是生活在70年代，但在我阅读和观看的东西里有，所以我不知道具体是谁说的。

sentences.en: But, I mean, that's what it's saying is that if you don't make your intuitive function conscious, then it will remain unconscious and that unconsciousness will control you.
sentences.zh: 但是，我的意思是，这说明如果你不让你的直觉功能变得有意识，那么它就会保持无意识，而这种无意识将控制你。

sentences.en: So a lot of the people that are in these, no one ever said, I mean, remember the diagnosis of the cult leader is right.
sentences.zh: 所以很多身处其中的人，从来没有人说过——记住，对邪教领袖的诊断是正确的。

sentences.en: No one ever said, hey, look, you don't have to be sick to be important.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人说过，嘿，听着，你不需要生病才能变得重要。

sentences.en: You are important.
sentences.zh: 你是重要的。

sentences.en: You don't have to, you are an effective actor.
sentences.zh: 你不需要，你是一个有效的行动者。

sentences.en: You don't have to make movies on behalf of this other, your director, writer, you know, you don't have to make movies on behalf of this other person's religious thing.
sentences.zh: 你不需要代表这个其他人、你的导演、编剧拍电影，你知道的，你不需要代表另一个人的宗教事务拍电影。

sentences.en: You can find a point within yourself that you want to tell, that you want to say.
sentences.zh: 你可以在自己内心找到一个你想讲述、你想表达的观点。

sentences.en: You know, all of these things that get worse when you have a civilization basically that is cutting off past actualization and it's not functioning,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所有这些事情，当你的文明基本上切断了过去的自我实现且它无法运转时，情况就会变得更糟，

sentences.en: people statistically will just hear less and then people will get worse.
sentences.zh: 从统计学上讲，人们只会听到更少的声音，然后人们的状态会变得更糟。

sentences.en: They'll be more susceptible to these things.
sentences.zh: 他们会更容易受到这些事物的影响。

sentences.en: So you hear cult used kind of too much.
sentences.zh: 所以你听到“邪教”这个词被用得有点太泛滥了。

sentences.en: Like I think a lot of times, um, remember when we're talking about cults here, you know, a conspiracy theory is a metaphor that describes a reality,
sentences.zh: 就像我认为很多时候，嗯，记住当我们在这里讨论邪教时，你知道的，阴谋论是一个描述现实的隐喻，

sentences.en: a reality with a metaphor that we can't, where we can't see reality clearly.
sentences.zh: 一个用我们无法清晰看清现实的隐喻来描述的现实。

sentences.en: We don't really know what is actually happening under the hood.
sentences.zh: 我们并不真正知道幕后到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: And so we make this gas and then we become too certain about that gas,
sentences.zh: 于是我们做出这种猜测，然后我们对这种猜测变得过于笃定，

sentences.en: whereas a cult is something that is replacing a part of you with something that feels easier or more authentic.
sentences.zh: 而邪教则是用某种让你觉得更轻松或更真实的东西来替代你的一部分。

sentences.en: But ultimately there's going to be this bait and switch where that thing is going to control you and it's going to cut you off from authenticity so that you're trapped.
sentences.zh: 但最终会有这样一个骗局，那东西会控制你，并切断你与真实的联系，使你陷入困境。

sentences.en: That is how they're going to function.
sentences.zh: 这就是它们的运作方式。

sentences.en: So when you see people say, well, this political party is a cult or that both political parties are cults or, you know, this, the entire religion of this is a cult or something.
sentences.zh: 所以当你看到人们说，这个政党是一个邪教，或者这两个政党都是邪教，或者，你知道的，这个的整个宗教是一个邪教什么的。

sentences.en: I have a problem with that kind of language because I don't think, um, cults can quite be that big, you know,
sentences.zh: 我对这种语言有意见，因为我不认为，嗯，邪教能有那么大，你知道的，

sentences.en: like are most Americans affiliated with some organization somewhere that they don't understand how it works and it exploits them?
sentences.zh: 就像大多数美国人都附属于某个他们不理解其运作方式且剥削他们的组织吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Like, you know, almost definitely.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，几乎百分之百是的。

sentences.en: Um, but you know, what is that?
sentences.zh: 但是你知道，那是什么？

sentences.en: That's a problem that needs to change, but that's the, that's the problem.
sentences.zh: 那是一个需要改变的问题，但那就是，那就是问题所在。

sentences.en: I'm driving the cult.
sentences.zh: 我在操控邪教。

sentences.en: You know, it isn't really the cult.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它其实并不是邪教。

sentences.en: It isn't really a conspiracy theory.
sentences.zh: 它其实不是阴谋论。

sentences.en: It is the system not working as intended.
sentences.zh: 它是系统没有按预期运转。

sentences.en: And there is an inevitability that I want to leave you with where when, when two, two parties offer, you know, pathway to where most people want to go.
sentences.zh: 我想留给你们一个必然的结论，当两个政党都提供通往大多数人想去的地方的途径，

sentences.en: And there's no pathway for another party to exist politically in a country when you don't have humanities and liberal arts to put us in touch with history.
sentences.zh: 而一个国家里没有让另一个政党在政治上存在的途径时，当你没有新人文学科和通识教育来让我们接触历史时，

sentences.en: Um, uh, you know, our, and I don't mean history, like the textbook history.
sentences.zh: 嗯，呃，你知道的，我们的，我指的不是历史，像教科书那样的历史。

sentences.en: I mean, the, our own cultural history and tradition that makes these things that I think we see as modern inventions or modern realities, we, it cuts them off from us.
sentences.zh: 我指的是，我们自己的文化历史和传统，使这些我认为我们视为现代发明或现代现实的东西，与我们隔绝开来。

sentences.en: We're really seeing their ancient nature or the archetypal nature of how they work.
sentences.zh: 我们真正看到的是它们的古代本质或它们运作的原型本质。

sentences.en: Again, that psychology is real, you know, um, I, I think, you know, James Hillman, the psychologist, the Indian psychologist has this,
sentences.zh: 再次强调，心理学是真实的，你知道的，嗯，我，我想，你知道的，心理学家詹姆斯·希尔曼，这位印第安心理学家有这样一个观点，

sentences.en: that acorn theory about how like you may feel crazy because you're an acorn that got thrown into a sunflower field, but you were just an acorn.
sentences.zh: 那个橡果理论，关于你可能会觉得自己疯了，因为你是一颗被扔进向日葵田的橡果，但你其实只是一颗橡果。

sentences.en: Like you were born with this inner spark that you have to actualize.
sentences.zh: 就像你生来就带着必须去实现的内在火花。

sentences.en: And we all have that.
sentences.zh: 我们都有这个。

sentences.en: And when you are not seeing a way to become what you were supposed to be, then just our psychology is going to make us deflect, defer,
sentences.zh: 当你看不到成为你本该成为的样子的途径时，我们的心理就会让我们去转移、拖延，

sentences.en: or project that pathway to actualization onto shortcuts.
sentences.zh: 或者将那种通往自我实现的途径投射到捷径上。

sentences.en: And those shortcuts are going to be cults and conspiracy theories that are going to hurt us and hurt people around us.
sentences.zh: 而这些捷径将是会伤害我们及周围人的邪教和阴谋论。

sentences.en: And unless you fix the systemic problem that is always going to be exploiting and enabling these things to exist and then scapegoating them a lot of the time, pretending that,
sentences.zh: 除非你解决那个总是会剥削并促使这些事物存在、然后大部分时间还将它们当作替罪羊的系统性问题，假装认为，

sentences.en: well, these people are just crazy.
sentences.zh: 这些人只是疯了。

sentences.en: Well, those people are just stupid instead of like, our world doesn't work and it should work better.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那些人只是愚蠢，而不是去承认，我们的世界没有运转好，它本该运转得更好。

sentences.en: You know, they're, they're a deflection away from systemic problems in a way that I don't think is good.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它们，它们是以一种我认为并不好的方式转移了对系统性问题的注意力。

sentences.en: And will these problems always be around?
sentences.zh: 这些问题会一直存在吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, have they always been around?
sentences.zh: 你知道，它们一直存在吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Can we notice that the system is broken and that people who want to grow and change are being cut off from authentic pathways to actualization?
sentences.zh: 我们能否注意到系统已经崩溃，并且渴望成长和改变的人们正被切断通往自我实现的真实途径？

sentences.en: Again, when these things increase in frequency, intensity, and duration?
sentences.zh: 再次强调，当这些事情在频率、强度和持续时间上增加时？
